Berlin: Language Science Press. Sec. 3.3.1.1 'Sumba phonology' pp.140-142; Table 3.50; sec. 3.4.3; Appendix A.1 p.732.

sources.note: Family-level only, p.141: 'Languages of Sumba have vowel epenthesis.. The epenthetic vowel is extra-metrical and does not shift stress from the penultimate vowel of the root' (examples Kambera, Weyewa, Mamboru, Kodi). Nothing specific to Baliledo/Pondok; Appendix A.1 lists no data source for either lect.
